description: Weighted audit rules for roadmap contract quality scoring. Rules evaluate the normalized contract produced from ROADMAP.md and contribute to a 0-100 maturity score.

rules.name: roadmap-file-present
rules.description: A ROADMAP.md or equivalent file exists at the requested path.
rules.message: No ROADMAP.md file found. The repository has no roadmap contract.

rules.name: roadmap-parseable
rules.description: The roadmap can be parsed into at least one checklist item.
rules.message: Roadmap exists but is not parseable. No checkbox items were found.
rules.recommendedAction: Add release-scoped checklist items using '- [ ]' and '- [x]' syntax.

rules.name: roadmap-has-pending-work
rules.description: The roadmap contains at least one unchecked item unless it is intentionally archived.
rules.message: All roadmap checklist items are complete. No pending dispatch target is visible.
rules.recommendedAction: Add the next planned release or archive this roadmap and create a new active roadmap.

rules.name: has-product-intent-section
rules.description: The roadmap includes a Product Intent, Scope, or Purpose section describing what the product does and who it serves.
rules.message: No Product Intent, Scope, or Purpose section was detected.
rules.recommendedAction: Add a Product Intent section near the top describing the product, users, and problem solved.

rules.name: uses-release-sections
rules.description: Work is organized into release-scoped sections using '## Release X.Y — Title'.
rules.message: Roadmap does not use release-scoped sections.
rules.recommendedAction: Reorganize work into bounded release sections with stable release identifiers.

rules.name: each-release-has-acceptance-criteria
rules.description: Every non-archived release has explicit acceptance criteria.
rules.message: One or more non-archived releases are missing acceptance criteria.
rules.recommendedAction: Add observable acceptance criteria to every active, planned, blocked, validation, or done release.

rules.name: each-release-has-out-of-scope-boundaries
rules.description: Every non-archived release explicitly states what is out of scope.
rules.message: One or more non-archived releases are missing out-of-scope boundaries.
rules.recommendedAction: Add an Out of scope section to each release to prevent scope creep and agent overreach.

rules.name: sufficient-pending-item-count
rules.description: A pending roadmap should contain at least three unchecked concrete items for reliable agent dispatch.
rules.message: Fewer than three pending roadmap items were found.
rules.recommendedAction: Add enough concrete, testable milestones to give an agent reliable execution context.

rules.name: has-multiple-releases
rules.description: The roadmap defines at least two releases to provide forward visibility.
rules.message: Fewer than two release sections were found.
rules.recommendedAction: Add at least one future release section for forward planning.

rules.name: no-vague-checklist-items
rules.description: Checklist items are concrete and testable, not vague placeholders.
rules.message: One or more checklist items appear to be vague placeholders.
rules.recommendedAction: Replace vague items with concrete, testable, implementation-specific milestones.

rules.name: single-active-release
rules.description: At most one release is in active execution state at a time.
rules.message: More than one active, blocked, or validation release was detected.
rules.recommendedAction: Keep exactly one active execution target. Move other releases to planned, done, or archived.

rules.name: active-release-has-validation-plan
rules.description: The active release includes a validation plan with concrete test or verification signals.
rules.message: The active release does not include a concrete validation plan.
rules.recommendedAction: Add a Validation plan section with specific commands, smoke tests, or manual verification steps.

rules.name: active-release-has-traceability
rules.description: The active release links work to issues, PRs, commits, ADRs, tests, docs, or workflows.
rules.message: The active release has no explicit traceability references.
rules.recommendedAction: Add links or references to issues, PRs, commits, ADRs, tests, workflows, or docs.

rules.name: done-releases-have-no-unchecked-items
rules.description: A release marked done should not contain unchecked checklist items.
rules.message: One or more done releases still contain unchecked checklist items.
rules.recommendedAction: Either complete those items, move them to a future release, or change the release status.

rules.name: known-status-vocabulary
rules.description: Release statuses use the canonical vocabulary or configured aliases.
rules.message: One or more releases use an unknown status value.
rules.recommendedAction: Use planned, active, blocked, validation, done, or archived.

L1-Informal.description: Roadmap exists but is flat, vague, unparseable, or structurally unsafe.

L2-Structured.description: Roadmap has checklist structure and some organization, but is not yet a reliable dispatch contract.

L3-Contract-Ready.description: Roadmap is release-scoped, parseable, and suitable for supervised agent dispatch.

L4-Orchestration-Ready.description: Roadmap passes all critical and warning rules and is suitable for autonomous or semi-autonomous orchestration.

maturityCaps.reason: A missing roadmap cannot be above L0.
An unparseable roadmap cannot be above L1.
A roadmap without release sections cannot be contract-ready.
A roadmap with missing acceptance criteria cannot be contract-ready.
L4 requires zero critical and warning findings.
